desc.zh: 用剩余字母计数，推导记忆化搜索与安全的分支筛选。
desc.en: Derive memoized search and safe branch filtering from missing letter counts.

complexity: O(nLm + nmS) time; O(nm + mS + m²) auxiliary space, S = product(count(c)+1) <= 2^m

concepts.name: Remaining-letter memoization
concepts.description: Cache the minimum additional stickers by immutable missing-letter counts.

concepts.name: Pivot-letter branch filtering
concepts.description: Reorder any solution to begin with a sticker covering a chosen missing letter.
